name: Bench Mark Infotech Services Limited
summary: A recently listed IT project integrator with rapid reported growth but weak cumulative cash conversion and a specific bank-versus-book reconciliation exception. Completed annual financing models retain IPO cash and all legacy claims; ordinary cases are funded, yet the reference return is below the hurdle. Reliability, not an unperformed valuation, prevents investment certification.

sections.title: Executive Verdict
sections.text: Bench Mark is an IT infrastructure and project integrator, not recurring SaaS. Reported growth and new government orders are real supporting evidence, but receivable accumulation, nonrecurring writebacks and a specific bank/book exception constrain reliability. Completed linked models give bear/base/bull terminal values ₹52.02/₹180.50/₹355.83 versus the dated ₹213 entry. Ordinary paths are funded by the IPO without further borrowing, yet even the favorable return is below the 15% hurdle. G2 remains unresolved for a specific disclosure reconciliation, not because calculations were deferred. [S1] [S3] [S4] [S90]

sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text: Cutoff: 20 October 2026. BMISL/INE2OKU01014 listed on NSE SME on 5 October 2026. Official 19 October close ₹213, actual 14,272,650 shares and 1,200-share lot control the dated analysis. Restated FY2024–26 standalone Indian GAAP is separated from FY2022–23 originals. Five annual operating periods end March2031, with about4.447 years from October entry, rather than a fictitious full five-year return clock. A 15% nominal return hurdle and₹5 lakh position are analyst conventions, not user suitability inputs. March opening balances plus FY2027 IPO flows are modeled; October cash is not invented. [S1] [S4] [S5] [S6] [S90] [S91]

sections.title: Scorecard and Calculation Audit
sections.text: BQS 5.04, GQS 6.00; IAS raw 2.710, final NS under G2. All factor arithmetic and raw bounds are retained. No persistent CAP/CASH cap is assumed; quality rankings are excluded for reliability. GOV 4, MOAT 4, REV 8, DUR 5, CAP 6, CASH 3, BAL 7, EXEC 5 and EARN 4 are supported with contrary evidence. R 1 uses the explicit return-spread rule, D 2 stress recovery, P 2 reverse expectations, and L 5 the short listed trading sample after implementation downgrades. Forward point estimates have Low confidence while coarse weak investment bands are robust; the G2 override still prevents an IAS certification. A one-point CAP/CASH sensitivity changes BQS 0.22/GQS 0.25. [S1] [S4] [S90]

sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: The company designs and delivers integrated IT, networking, surveillance and institutional digital-infrastructure systems. Hardware procurement and direct project expenses are major pass-through costs; gross sales are not software ARR. Contract award, execution, acceptance and collection can occur in different periods. FY2026 top10 customers account for 94.19% of sales; the top customer falls to 25.21% from 60.93%, an improvement but not diversification sufficient to remove project lumpiness. Government receivables₹34.7113 crore and nongovernment₹20.2683 crore form the₹54.9796 crore net book. [S1] [S4]

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Eligibility, technical integration and past project references help tender qualification but do not establish durable pricing power. Bid success declines 41.07%→37.25%→30.43%, with disclosed winning value falling from₹17.9882 crore to ₹10.4044 crore. RHP comparators Dynacons, Xtranet and Esconet are systems-integrator archetypes, not SaaS peers. Its displayed price/EPS/P-E columns do not reconcile: Dynacons 276.09/66.64 is 4.14, not 26.55. Corporate-action and price-basis differences may explain the presentation, but no unverified peer multiple is imported. Assumed exit multiples are explicit scenario inputs rather than a fabricated current median. [S1] [S4]

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: Restated revenue FY2024/25/26 is₹34.0951/50.0385/60.5276 crore: additions₹15.9434 crore then₹10.4891 crore, growth 46.76% then 20.96%, and two-year CAGR 33.24%. This is two intervals, not three. Signed originals show FY2022/23 revenue₹28.52379/25.493895 crore and a 10.62% contraction, but those originals are not harmonized to the IPO restatement. They supply cycle caution, not a falsely clean five-year series. Price, hardware mix and acceptance timing limit demand-volume inference; projected facility output is excluded from demonstrated REV. [S1] [S4] [S5]

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text: Government and institutional digitization provides reachable demand, but the collection cycle makes growth capital-intensive. Management projected WC₹30.2164 crore/₹51.5857 crore in FY2027/28 versus₹13.0837 crore FY2026 on its own presentation, including IPO use₹10 crore/₹20 crore; these are forecasts, not realized balances. The analytical WC definition excludes net income tax, gratuity and accrued interest for separate settlement and therefore differs. October 14 orders total₹9.9759 crore inclusive of taxes, concentrated in two large orders; not all this amount becomes revenue or cash immediately. BIADA land supports only a potential assembly/integration/testing facility, with no funded construction or incremental production assumed in the reference. [S1] [S3] [S4]

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: The final prospectus reports material differences between debtors in the books and amounts submitted to the bank. For FY2026 Q3, ₹52.0313 crore less ₹35.3301 crore equals ₹16.7012 crore, whereas the displayed difference is ₹2.6478 crore. Management attributes discrepancies to provisional statements and year-end adjustments; that explanation does not reconcile the displayed arithmetic. This is a financial-reliability exception, not a finding of fabricated sales, fraud or an equivalent receivable loss. The RHP also discloses pending Shani Peripherals arbitration over invoices and claimed profit share, with an earlier insolvency application dismissed for a pre-existing dispute. Dismissal is not proof that the disputed amount was collected, and subsequent disposition was not verified. FY2026 related-party sales₹2.5725 crore are 4.25% of revenue; adding loans, purchases and reimbursements to obtain 11.23% does not measure related sales. Director remuneration₹1.32 crore, unpaid remuneration₹1.0564 crore and interest-free promoter debt₹1.377 crore are separate items. The model keeps unpaid operating remuneration inside WC and repays promoter debt in year 1, rather than omitting either. RHP company tax proceedings total₹0.1934 crore; their disclosure is not an adjudicated misconduct finding. IPO and new orders are completed milestones; collection and facility completion remain unproven. [S1] [S3] [S4]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text: FY2024/25/26 PAT₹1.4802/5.8304/10.218 crore contrasts with CFO₹4.8662/6.5391/−6.7652 crore, cumulative conversion 0.2647. FY2026 creditor writeback₹2.9347 crore is 21.52% of PBT, but strict EBIT excluding all other income still grows from₹7.6212 crore to ₹10.7509 crore; EBITDA is₹10.8445 crore. Bad-debt expense₹0.4138 crore and sundry writeoffs₹1.1099 crore remain operating costs rather than automatic addbacks. Restatement reduces FY2026 PAT from₹11.7319 crore to ₹10.218 crore; gratuity, tax, depreciation and earlier items explain differences, not a fabricated clean history. Net good receivables older than one year are₹9.7583 crore, excluding₹0.4138 crore disputed debt already fully provided. Reported CFO less PPE and property-advance cash spend gives−₹7.9736 crore. Deposits partly move through CFO, so classification is not ignored. Accrual NOPAT on average all-funds capital is about 34.7%, incremental about 19.3%; these strong accounting returns require collection corroboration. Current-issued reported PAT/share₹7.16 differs from pre-IPO EPS ₹9.40. [S1] [S4]

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text: The annual model starts with cash₹1.0914 crore, separate deposits₹9.158 crore, mutual funds₹0.735 crore and security/EMD₹1.8276 crore. Actual IPO fresh shares enter once with prospectus-estimated net cash₹34.5944 crore; OFS does not fund the issuer. Deposits remain separate rather than presumed released. Base growth 15/12/10/10/8%, EBITDA 16%, AR 300 days, trade payables 45% of sales, other operating liabilities 10%, inventory 2%, advances 2.5%, maintenance capex 1.5% and 12× exit EBIT are assumptions. Security/EMD capital scales with sales. Current net tax₹2.0736 crore, current gratuity₹0.1263 crore and accrued MSME interest₹0.1793 crore settle once. Unfunded NC gratuity₹0.3107 crore remains terminal; no plan assets exist. DTA₹1.2449 crore is not automatically cash. BIADA advance₹1.4903 crore plus commitment₹1.5097 crore funds one₹3 crore asset, not duplicated capex. Base terminal₹180.50 returns-3.66%; bull₹355.83 returns12.23%. Ordinary cases require no additional debt. Meeting 15% needs 35.37% annual growth under otherwise unchanged assumptions. [S4] [S90]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: Ordinary bear combines an initial 10% sales fall, 10% EBITDA, 365-day AR, 35% payable funding, 8× EBIT and50% noncore recovery; terminal₹52.02 loses roughly 75.6% of entry. Good aged-AR loss 50% reduces opening realizable WC by₹4.87915 crore and replacement funding enters once; already-provided debt is not charged again. Combined severe stress reduces available IPO cash by₹20 crore, stretches AR to 450 days, lowers payable funding to 20% and calls₹4.9804 crore guarantees. The no-credit path fails, while a conditional-credit path is separately modeled, not guaranteed. Individual sensitivities give base terminal about ₹137.23 at 12% margin,₹167.79 at 365-day AR and₹168.80 under a₹16.7012 crore collection loss. The last is a stress amount derived from the bank/book gap, not a finding that the gap is bad debt. [S1] [S4] [S90]

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: At ₹213, fivefold terminal value requires roughly 68.45% annual growth, terminal sales₹821.00 crore, cash capex₹29.58 crore and new borrowing₹42.14 crore under the reference economic ratios. Tenfold requires 94.97% growth, sales₹1,705.15 crore, capex₹52.16 crore and borrowing₹205.03 crore. The15% hurdle itself requires terminal₹396.51 over the actual 4.447-year holding clock, not the previous five-year shorthand₹428.42. These are reverse funding calculations, not forecasts or a TAM-based probability claim. Recent 20.96% growth and weak collections do not support a multibagger designation. [S4] [S90]

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text: Reconcile each quarterly bank/book debtor submission and obtain a corrected difference column. Track₹54.9796 crore net AR and₹9.7583 crore good balances over one year against actual receipts and project acceptance. Compare CFO with recurring EBIT after removing creditor writebacks. Verify actual remaining IPO cash, expenses and working-capital deployment rather than assuming all October cash is untouched. Monitor payable ageing, MSME interest and net tax settlement, promoter-loan repayment and FD collateral conditions. Check tax-exclusive order conversion and bid success against 30.43%, customer concentration against 94.19%, and BIADA payment/development milestones. Refresh short-term ASM, circuits, lot size and execution depth before any position decision. [S1] [S3] [S4] [S90] [S96]

sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text: Completed conditional-model review; reliability hold and weak investment economics, not an investable compounder certification. Quality arithmetic is retained but excluded from rankings under G2. The 11 listed sessions have mean traded value₹39.2586 million and median₹14.8177 million, implying₹5 lakh exit about 0.675 days at5%, 1.687 days at2% and 0.337 days at10%; these are short-sample capacity estimates, not valid 20/60-day averages. One lot costs₹255,600, two₹511,200, so rounding down changes the reference amount. Active short-term ASM stage I and the exchange irregular-trading caution require implementation care, not a fraud or suspension inference. A better price alone would not reconcile accounts. [S90] [S91] [S93] [S95] [S96]

sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Primary final prospectus, RHP, signed older accounts, order filing and official dated market data were inspected in relevant sections. The original FY2023 shareholder note has formatting/arithmetic anomalies, so current ownership percentages are not copied from it; final offer capital controls share reconciliation. Actual post-IPO cash and collection statements are unavailable in the inspected announcements. The model handles this with full-year cash flows and proceeds-use sensitivities rather than declaring all IPO funds unusable. FD receipt-based verification is not independent confirmation. Bank/book reliability, subsequent dispute outcomes, receivable realizability, collateral release and facility economics remain open. Model QA checks arithmetic, not those underlying facts. [S1] [S4] [S5] [S90]

GOV.reason: Restatement corrections, a specific bank/book discrepancy and material unpaid related remuneration constrain stewardship to 4. Contrary: related sales are 4.25%, not 11.23%; disclosed approvals and unmodified underlying opinions do not support a severe integrity-failure allegation.

MOAT.reason: Tender qualifications and integration capability are useful, but falling bid success and94.19% top10 concentration oppose durable pricing power. Contrary: operating growth and fresh wins show a real business, not absence of capability.

REV.reason: Two-year comparable restated CAGR 33.24% anchors the high-growth band, capped 8 for Medium confidence and only two intervals. FY2026 growth slows to 20.96%; older original FY2023 contraction is contrary cycle evidence, not silently combined into a harmonized series.

DUR.reason: Government/institutional digitization and disclosed recent orders support an accessible runway. Contrary: orders are tax-inclusive, tender success weakens and long collections absorb funding; no SaaS recurring-revenue or broad TAM bonus.

CAP.reason: Accrual operating return on average all-funds capital is about 34.7%, with recent incremental return about 19.3%. Stronger than cost of capital on paper, but capital is tied in aged receivables and supplier finance, so6 reflects unproven realization rather than exceptional durable returns.

CASH.reason: Three-year CFO/PAT 0.2647 and FY2026 negative CFO 6.7652 support 3; property advances also consume cash. Contrary: the prior two years generated positive CFO and FY2026 expense writeoffs do not all represent new cash outflow. No persistent override is asserted solely from the low factor.

BAL.reason: The fresh issue materially funds ordinary base and bear with no additional credit, while both FD pools remain separate assets. Contrary: actual October cash is unverified, collateral is not freely swept and combined collection/claim stress fails without credit. This supports 7 conditional on the disclosed financing bridge, not an unconditional cash-surplus declaration.

EXEC.reason: Reported sales scale and October orders are positive delivery evidence. Contrary: tender wins and receivable realization lag, and the proposed facility has no completed production record. Mixed execution supports 5.

EARN.reason: Strict operating EBIT grows after removing all other income, so earnings growth is not entirely a writeback. Nevertheless creditor release2.9347, prior-period restatements, DTA credits and weak collections constrain earnings quality to 4.

R.reason: Reference return−3.66% versus15% hurdle gives a spread about −18.66 percentage points, R 1. Even the favorable modeled return 12.23% is below the hurdle. Coarse low-return band is supportable despite uncertain point forecasts and separate G2 exclusion.

D.reason: Ordinary bear retains₹52.02, a roughly 75.6% entry-value loss. The combined severe collection/supplier/BG stress fails without credit. Contrary: IPO funding, deposits and continuing project activity support some recovery; the assessment is not zero-business-value rhetoric.

P.reason: Meeting 15% requires35.37% annual growth for five modeled periods at16% EBITDA and 12× exit EBIT, above the latest20.96% rate while AR remains300 days. Possible but demanding concurrent execution supports 2, not an assumed rerating cushion.

L.reason: The 11-session median implies 0.675 days at5% participation, a provisional band 9 before penalties. Downgrade to 5 for very short history, active short-term ASM, circuit/execution uncertainty and₹255,600 lot granularity. One lot is feasible within the illustrative limit; two cost₹511,200. No nonexistent60-day record is invented.

Q.reason: Unrounded BQS reused once; no duplicate quality bonus.
